item.title: ‘I’ve Waited My Whole Life to Do This’: Watch Madonna’s Celeb Guests Film Their ‘Confessions II’ Cameos
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music plays]
Host: "Get ready to dance, folks! Madonna is back with her new album, Confessions II, and she's bringing some of Hollywood's biggest stars along for the ride. In a behind-the-scenes clip, we get to see the Queen of Pop in action, filming the sequence for her new song 'Danceteria'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The clip takes us back to the iconic New York City nightclub, Danceteria, which inspired the song. We see historic photos of the club, which hosted some wild nights in the 80s. And then, we're transported to the film set, where Madonna is recreating those vibes with a star-studded cast."
[Short sound effects: a nightclub ambiance]
Host: "Gwendoline Christie, Odessa A'zion, and even Benedict Cumberbatch make appearances in the film. We see Christie getting excited about dancing with Madonna, saying 'I've waited my whole life to do this!' And Cumberbatch, well, he's just ready to dance, saying 'Oh, yeah!' when Madonna asks if he's ready to bust a move."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Other big names in the sequence include Kate Moss, Honey Dijon, and Shygirl. And if you're curious to see more, the full album film is out now, featuring even more stars like Sabrina Carpenter and Julia Garner. Confessions II is Madonna's first LP since 2019's Madame X, so be sure to check it out. Get ready to dance, indeed!"
[Outro music plays]
